decisions.decision: Raw integer counts | DESeq2 median-of-ratios (internal) | ≥10 counts in ≥2 samples
decisions.question: Differential expression (DESeq2)
decisions.rationale: DESeq2 handles library-size normalization internally; external normalization would break the negative-binomial model assumptions.

decisions.decision: All count-matrix samples | Primary DE retains all samples | Design-safe removal is evaluated only as sensitivity
decisions.question: Sample outliers
decisions.rationale: Automatic pre-DE pruning can turn a null primary result into a significant result; ARIA reports primary and outlier-removal sensitivity separately.

decisions.decision: VST-transformed counts | Variance-Stabilizing Transformation (pydeseq2) | Top 2000 most-variable protein_coding genes
decisions.question: PCA + MDS (sample-level structure)
decisions.rationale: VST produces homoscedastic values suitable for Euclidean-based methods (DESeq2 authors' recommendation). Protein-coding filter removes pseudogene/ncRNA noise. Variable-gene filter focuses on informative signal.

decisions.decision: VST (or log2(counts+1) fallback) | Row z-score | 50 most significant DE genes (sorted by padj)
decisions.question: Heatmap (padj top 50)

decisions.decision: VST (or log2(counts+1) fallback) | Row z-score | 50 DE genes with largest effect sizes
decisions.question: Heatmap (|log2FC| top 50)
decisions.rationale: Complementary view — surfaces largest effect sizes, which may not have smallest padj for low-count genes.

decisions.decision: DE gene symbols | Local hypergeometric test against versioned GMT libraries (Enrichr is opt-in) | padj<0.05 from Wald lfcThreshold test; ORA universe = genes retained after expression filtering
decisions.question: Pathway enrichment (ORA)
decisions.rationale: Standard over-representation for discrete gene lists, computed locally against the dataset-expressed background so the gene list never leaves the machine (W-PRIV); the exact gene-set release is recorded in pathway_ora.gene_set_versions.

decisions.decision: All DE-tested genes ranked by log2FC | blitzgsea running sum | None (uses full ranking)
decisions.question: GSEA (pre-ranked)
decisions.rationale: More sensitive than ORA to coordinated small effects; complementary to cutoff-based enrichment.

decisions.decision: Raw counts + exon-union gene lengths | TPM (transcripts per million) | Genes with length annotation in GTF
decisions.question: TPM (supplementary export)
decisions.rationale: Supplementary table for downstream tools that require TPM (ssGSEA, deconvolution). NOT used by ARIA for DE or PCA — both use more appropriate methods.

decisions.question: Statistical thresholds for DE significance
decisions.rationale: |log2FC| threshold provenance: default. The default (1.0) is fixed and prompt-independent; it changes only via an explicit User Checkpoint 3 profile or a versioned global_lfc override (never inferred from the question text).

decisions.question: DESeq2 design formula
decisions.rationale: Single-factor design inferred from sample labels. No batch or covariate adjustment applied.
